in_hebrew.name: Gaskins
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו From the river Gask
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gaskins הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word 'gasc', meaning 'goose' or 'river'. This name is of English origin and is a common surname. In Scotland, the name Gaskins may be derived from Gask, a town located near the River Dee. In Ireland, it may be derived from the Irish name 'Gus Ó Caiside', meaning 'descendant of the fair-haired one'.
